verdict.rationale: llama.cpp's server exposes an HTTP API (llama serve) and its built-in web UI is itself just a client of that same API (gh-2, gh-3), implying the UI has no privileged capability beyond what the API offers. Additional evidence shows the server/API is the core interface used by CLI, Docker, and other tooling (gh-18, gh-11), reinforcing an API-first design. Missing for 10: explicit documentation enumerating full feature parity between UI and API endpoints, and independent verification that no UI-only settings/features exist.
